title: What Scripture Actually Means by Clothe Yourself With Humility
caption:
A godly man's humility isn't self-loathing.

Scripture says clothe yourself with it. Clothes are worn on purpose, not felt by accident.

Humility is worn, not felt. It's not thinking less of yourself. It shows up toward people who can't help him. And God opposes the proud, not the failing.

Not the successful. Not the put-together. The humble. That's who gets the grace he actually needs.
